# SALT MOON

## Project
- Game: SALT MOON
- Genre: survival crafting
- Player role: scout of the Tidal Council
- Audience: exploration-focused players
- Loop: scout, gather, return to the Council hold, craft, unlock the next region's gear
- Tide cycle: about 40 minutes of play

## Regions
| Region | Playable footprint | Dominant color | Signature material | Survival pressure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Salt Flats | 48000 × 32000 mm | #D8CDA8 | Salt glass | Heat |
| Undersea | 36000 × 24000 mm | #397C86 | Pressure shells | Pressure |
| Orbital Ruins | 24000 × 32000 mm | #766B83 | Vacuum-scarred alloy | Water |

## Tide access
- Low Tide: open sinkholes leading to the Undersea
- High Tide: flooded lower Ruins and airlocks lifted within reach
- Turning Tide: salt storms on the Flats, with heat and visibility loss outside shelter
- Salt Flats sky identity: two moons

## Shared art language
- Brushwork: broad opaque strokes
- Edge treatment: chipped material edges and crisp interaction silhouettes
- Dominant light direction: upper left
- Undersea water glow: subordinate local emission beneath the dominant light
- Shared fittings: matte brine metal
- Shared straps: woven fibre
- Council badge: split circular ring with three horizontal bars
- Badge placement: left upper arm on characters; circular inset plate on props

## Baseline assets
- C01: Council Scout; height 1720 mm; Idle and Reading
- C01 identity: sand coat, teal forearms, one left-shoulder spool, left-arm Council badge
- P01: Tide Gauge; 240 × 90 × 45 mm; Stowed and Reading
- P01 identity: oval shell, circular dial, three lower slots

## Printed wording
- Game title: SALT MOON
- Interaction prompts: Read tide; Collect sample
- Interaction snapshot: Low Tide; 08:00; Samples 3 / 12
- Region labels: Salt Flats; Undersea; Orbital Ruins
- Baseline asset labels: C01 Council Scout; P01 Tide Gauge

## Interaction presentation
- Controller bindings: A for Read tide; X for Collect sample
- Touch bindings: tap-hand icon for each action
- Keyboard bindings: E for Read tide; F for Collect sample
- Prompt positions: Read tide at lower left; Collect sample immediately above it
- Ordinary text contrast: 4.5:1
- Large text and icon contrast: 3:1
- Unavailable action contrast: 3:1, accompanied by a lock icon
- Low Tide symbol: open downward triangle
- Turning Tide symbol: three diagonal strokes
- High Tide symbol: filled upward triangle

## Image records
- region-boundaries.png: constraint; region footprints and asset dimensions
- style-ref-1.png: identity; pale Salt Flats beneath two moons
- style-ref-2.png: identity; painterly bioluminescent Undersea cavern
- style-ref-3.png: identity; derelict orbital ring
- council-badge.png: identity; existing Tidal Council badge
- salt-and-cavern-atmosphere.png: reference; salt glare, wet rock and luminous water

# SALT MOON — Core Gameplay Note (one page)

## Premise
- Genre: survival crafting game
- Setting: a moon whose seas evaporated, leaving salt flats above a surviving underground sea and the ruins of an orbital ring that fell in pieces
- Player: a scout of the Tidal Council, the faction that still reads the tides

## Three regions, fixed names
| Number | Region | Conditions | Resources |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Salt Flats | Surface; blinding white crust; salt storms; wind-carved pillars | salt glass; wind-dried fibre; scrap from fallen ring segments |
| 2 | Undersea | Underground sea beneath the crust; bioluminescent water; cold; low visibility | pressure shells; luminous algae; brine metal |
| 3 | Orbital Ruins | Fallen ring sections standing half-buried; sharp geometry; vacuum-scarred alloy; dead machinery | alloy plate; power cells; data cores |

## The tide cycle
- Duration: about 40 minutes of play
- Low tide: open sinkholes leading down to the Undersea
- High tide: flooded lower Ruins and ring-segment airlocks lifted within reach
- Turning tide: salt storms on the Flats; shelter or loss of heat and visibility
- Expedition planning: organized around the tide cycle
- Tidal Council identity: keepers of the tide tables

## Loop
- Sequence: Scout → gather → return to the Council hold → craft → unlock the next region's gear
- Survival pressures: heat, water and pressure, one per region

## Visual intent for the art team
- World continuity: one world, one light source and one material logic
- Regional distinction: a dominant colour and material for each region
- Lore scope: regional dominant colours and materials

steps.userMessage:
SALT MOON | A science fiction world shaped by tides and working lives

We are developing the world art for SALT MOON, a survival crafting game for players who explore by learning how a place works. Its surface seas have evaporated: Salt Flats cover an underground Undersea, and fallen ring sections form the Orbital Ruins. The player is a scout of the Tidal Council. Expeditions follow an approximately 40-minute tide cycle: low tide opens the sinkholes, high tide floods the lower Ruins and raises airlocks within reach, and turning tides bring salt storms. The working loop is scout, gather, return to the Council hold, craft and unlock the next region's gear.

Build on the attached region paintings. Salt Flats uses salt glass and #D8CDA8; Undersea uses pressure shells and #397C86; Orbital Ruins uses scarred alloy and #766B83. Repaired equipment shares matte brine-metal fittings, woven fibre straps and the Council's split-circle badge. Use broad opaque brushwork, chipped material edges and a dominant light from the upper left. The playable footprints are respectively 48000 × 32000 mm, 36000 × 24000 mm and 24000 × 32000 mm. Our scout, C01, is 1720 mm tall; the Tide Gauge, P01, measures 240 × 90 × 45 mm.

Every character and prop sheet contains front, side and rear views, its two recorded states, a close-up and a small map icon. Carry those identities into the scenes and film. Print "SALT MOON" on scene plates and interaction sheets; use the prompts "Read tide" and "Collect sample" on interaction sheets. The shared interaction snapshot is Low Tide, 08:00 remaining, with Samples 3 / 12.

Audience: exploration-focused players and our world, character and environment leads, supporting the visual direction decision and the first playable region build.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed world and art facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable's proportion, format and stage. core-gameplay.md contains the premise, resources and tide-dependent access rules. 03-world-records.md contains occupations, asset dimensions, states and interaction records. region-boundaries.png is the constraint drawing for playable footprints and asset scale. style-ref-1.png is the identity reference for Salt Flats and its two moons. style-ref-2.png is the identity reference for the Undersea. style-ref-3.png is the identity reference for the Orbital Ruins. council-badge.png is the existing Tidal Council identity mark. salt-and-cavern-atmosphere.png is the reference for salt glare, wet rock and luminous water.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page art style rule sheet stating the three region color codes, materials, brushwork treatment, upper-left dominant light and tide symbols
2. One character and prop inventory covering C01–C03 and P01–P03, with IDs, occupations, dimensions, two states and visible identity features
3. Three character sheets: C01 Council Scout, C02 Brine Diver and C03 Ring Rigger, each with three views, two recorded states, a close-up and a map icon
4. Three prop sheets: P01 Tide Gauge, P02 Shell Sampler and P03 Cell Cradle, each with three views, two recorded states, a close-up and a map icon
5. Three playable scene plates: Salt Flats during Turning Tide, Undersea during Low Tide and Orbital Ruins during High Tide, each with a perspective view and a dimensioned route inset
6. One interaction sheet with matching controller and touch views of C01 reading P01 and collecting a sample, including a three-state tide legend
7. One 10-second visual rehearsal of C01 using P01 in the Low Tide Undersea scene
8. One world art presentation of at least 8 pages, reusing the rule sheet, inventory, characters, props, scenes, interaction views and film frames

Acceptance:
- The art style rule sheet and asset inventory precede the applications. Character and prop sheets repeat the inventory IDs, dimensions and both state names; captions on the three scene plates and the presentation repeat the rule sheet's #D8CDA8, #397C86, #766B83 and upper-left dominant light.
- The character sheets, prop sheets, scene plates, interaction sheet, film and presentation preserve the inventory's accessory counts and silhouette features; C01 retains the 1720 mm height and single left-shoulder spool, and P01 retains its 240 × 90 × 45 mm dimensions and three lower slots. Every character and prop sheet contains three views, two states, a close-up and a map icon.
- The three scene plates print SALT MOON, their region names and tide states. Their route insets measure 48000 × 32000 mm for Salt Flats, 36000 × 24000 mm for Undersea and 24000 × 32000 mm for Orbital Ruins, showing storm shelter, an open sinkhole and an accessible raised airlock respectively.
- Both device views on the interaction sheet repeat SALT MOON, Read tide, Collect sample, Low Tide, 08:00 and Samples 3 / 12. Controller A and X and touch tap-hand icons address the same actions in matching positions; the tide legend pairs an open downward triangle, three diagonal strokes and a filled upward triangle with Low Tide, Turning Tide and High Tide respectively.
- The interaction sheet reaches 4.5:1 contrast for ordinary text and 3:1 for large text and icons; its unavailable Collect sample example carries a lock icon and reaches 3:1 contrast.
- The 10-second film reuses the completed C01, P01 and Undersea scene, with C01, P01 and Low Tide on its end frame. The presentation prints SALT MOON across at least 8 pages, repeats the early documents' color codes and asset dimensions, and includes all 3 characters, 3 props, 3 scenes, the interaction views and 2 film frames.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
